title: Carlos Eire's They Flew and the historical flying saints
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Carlos Eire's They Flew and the historical flying saints, about 16th century and earlier at Europe, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's um a Yale professor, he's very well respected uh religious studies professor named uh Carlos Eire. He wrote a book called They Flew.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Carlos Eire, a respected religious studies professor at Yale University, and his book They Flew. Michels says the book looks at European saints said to have risen into the air, such as St. Joseph of Cupertino, Teresa of Avila and St. Francis of Assisi. He raises it because, if such accounts are true, people may have defied gravity long before modern reports of strange craft.
